task_as_i_read_it.description: the task as you read it, in your own words, one or two sentences, written before the work. The manager compares it with what was sent, so a misreading shows here.

narrowest_reading.description: only if the task was ambiguous: the narrowest reading you took, and what the other reading would have been. Empty if it was not ambiguous.

followups.description: work you found that mattered and did not do, one line each. Empty if there is none.

answers.description: One entry for every numbered thing the task asked for. If you could not answer one, say why in detail. Never leave a number out.

verification.description: the manager names the commands and the worker runs them

commit.description: the one commit made, or empty with the reason in a doubt

hit.description: what stopped you: a forbidden action, something not installed that you may not install yourself, or a part of the task that contradicts what the code actually does

needed_to_continue.description: exactly what you would need, or what the manager has to decide

redacted.description: true if anything was removed from this report for being a secret
